name: lablineage-guardian-workspace
description: LabLineage Guardian frontend and Google ADK backend workspace.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:web: wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:8788/api/health && npm run dev --workspace frontend
scripts.verify:git: npm run test:all && npm run build && npm run eval:agent --workspace backend && npm run validate:deployment --workspace backend && npm run validate:openapi --workspace backend && npm run validate:migrations --workspace backend && npm run validate:idempotency --workspace backend && npm run validate:workflows && npm run benchmark:ci --workspace collector
scripts.verify:push: npm run verify:git && npm run test:e2e
